title: Example payslip
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y10 lesson 13 (Example payslip (pupil PDF; figures are example data))
intro: Lesson 13: Earning, budgeting and saving. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

questions.q: What is the difference between gross pay and net pay?
questions.a: Gross is before deductions; net is what you take home after tax, NI and pension.

questions.q: Name two things Income Tax pays for.
questions.a: For example: the NHS, schools, roads, police

blocks.note: Example figures only; staff should replace them with the current year's rates if they want exact values.

keywords.def: money paid to the government from earnings
payments that build entitlement to the state pension and some benefits

questions.q: Pupil PDF: a budget from net pay of £1,370 including saving and sadaqah; it must balance.
questions.a: A balanced budget with saving first.

questions.q: Extend: what percentage of the example budget is saved?

questions.a: A) take-home pay after deductions. What actually arrives.

questions.q: Income tax and National Insurance are taken from ...
Think again: Your first job advert says £1,500 a month. Will £1,500 arrive in your bank?
questions.a: Usually less: tax and National Insurance are taken off before you are paid, if you earn above the thresholds.
